description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade scripts for OpenWrt firmware, including functions that check the firmware image and perform upgrades based on the board type, using environment variables and external commands.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image; always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process based on the detected board type. Sets environment variables and delegates to specific upgrade functions.
